about-us.title: About bymarccc — Custom-Made Fashion from Bucharest
about-us.description: bymarccc started in Bucharest with custom-made jeans. Today we make jeans and tops to each client's height and weight, and ship to London, Paris, the USA and beyond.
about-us.html:
bymarccc started in Bucharest, Romania, with one simple idea: jeans that are made for you, not for an average body.

Where we started

Our first pieces were custom-made jeans, patched and painted by hand, one pair at a time. Clients sent us their height and weight, and we cut and finished each pair so it fit the way it should. Word spread fast, and the small studio in Bucharest started shipping across Europe.

Where we are now

Today bymarccc is worn far beyond Romania. A big part of our clients are in London and Paris, and we ship to the USA, Canada and Australia. What has not changed is the way we work: every piece is still made to order, for the person who will wear it.

Made to your height and weight

When you order, you tell us your height and weight. We use them to adjust the length and fit before your piece leaves the studio. No guessing between two sizes, no hemming after delivery.

What we make

Statement denim with hand-applied patches and paint finishes, logo tops, hoodies and tees, leggings, blazers, jackets and our alien-logo bags. Bold designs, cut to fit you.

Materials

We work only with quality materials. Our cotton tops and tees are made with organic cotton from Portugal, and some of our pieces use sustainable, eco-conscious fabrics. We would rather make fewer, better pieces than chase volume.

Talk to us

Questions about sizing, an order or a custom idea? Write to contact@bymarccc.com or message us on WhatsApp at +40 750 257 490.

delivery-returns.title: Delivery & Returns — Shipping to Europe, UK, USA, Canada & Australia | bymarccc
delivery-returns.description: How fast bymarccc orders arrive in Romania, Europe, the UK, the USA, Canada and Australia, what shipping costs, and how returns work.
delivery-returns.html:
Every bymarccc piece is made to order and shipped from our studio in Bucharest, Romania, with tracking.

Delivery times

DestinationCourierDelivery time
RomaniaFan Courier3–5 working days
European Union, Switzerland, NorwayDHL Express5–7 working days
United KingdomDHL Express5–7 working days
USA & CanadaUPS Express7–9 working days
AustraliaDHL Express8–12 working days

You receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

Shipping costs

Shipping is calculated at checkout in your own currency: 20 RON in Romania, €15 (or the local equivalent) across Europe, £25 to the UK, and $30 (or the local equivalent) to the USA, Canada, Australia and the rest of the world.

Duties and taxes

Orders shipped outside the European Union, for example to the UK, Switzerland, the USA, Canada or Australia, may be subject to local import duties or taxes.

Returns

You can return your order within 14 days of delivery, as long as the pieces are unworn and still have their tags. Returns are free in Romania. From all other countries, you send the parcel back yourself, at your own cost, with the courier of your choice (for example DHL or your national post). To start a return, email contact@bymarccc.com or message us on WhatsApp at +40 750 257 490 with your order number, and we will send you the return address.

Once we receive and check the pieces, we refund you to the original payment method.

What cannot be returned

Made-to-measure length adjustments are final sale, because the piece has been cut to your height.

faq.title: FAQ — Shipping, Returns, Sizing & Custom-Made Orders | bymarccc
faq.description: Answers about bymarccc delivery times, returns, sizing by height and weight, payment and custom-made orders.
faqs: How quickly will my order arrive?

Romania: 3–5 working days with Fan Courier. European Union, Switzerland, Norway and the UK: 5–7 working days with DHL Express. USA and Canada: 7–9 working days with UPS Express. Australia: 8–12 working days with DHL Express. You get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.
Do you ship to my country?
Yes. We ship to every country in Europe, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia and most other countries worldwide. Prices and shipping are shown in your local currency.
How much does shipping cost?
20 RON in Romania, €15 (or the local equivalent) in Europe, £25 to the UK, and $30 (or the local equivalent) to the USA, Canada, Australia and the rest of the world.
Can I return my order?

Yes, within 14 days of delivery, unworn and with tags. Returns are free in Romania. From other countries you send the parcel back yourself, at your own cost, with the courier of your choice (for example DHL or your national post). Email contact@bymarccc.com or message us on WhatsApp with your order number to start a return.
Is anything final sale?
Made-to-measure length adjustments are final sale, because the piece is cut to your height.
Will I pay import duties?
Orders shipped outside the European Union, for example to the UK, Switzerland, the USA, Canada or Australia, may be subject to local import duties or taxes.
What does custom-made mean at bymarccc?
Every piece is made to order. At checkout you give us your height and weight, and we adjust the length and fit before shipping, so you do not have to guess between two sizes.
How do I choose my size?
Each product page has a size guide. For jeans, your height and weight matter most — we use them to adjust the length. If you are between sizes, message us and we will help.
What materials do you use?
Only quality materials. Our cotton tops and tees use organic cotton from Portugal, and some pieces use sustainable, eco-conscious fabrics. Every product page lists the exact composition.
Is every pair of jeans the same?
No. Our statement denim is patched and painted by hand, so no two pairs are identical.
How can I pay?
By card through our secure Stripe checkout, in your own currency. You can also split an order into 2 card payments. Cash on delivery is available in Romania only.
Where are you based?
Our studio is in Bucharest, Romania. Many of our clients are in London and Paris, and we ship to the USA, Canada and Australia.

posts.title: How to Find Jeans That Actually Fit: Why Height and Weight Beat Size Labels
posts.description: Size labels only tell half the story. Here is why we make jeans to your height and weight, and how to choose the right fit.
posts.html:
Two people can wear the same size and still need completely different jeans. That is why at bymarccc we ask for your height and weight before we finish your pair.

Why size labels are not enough

A waist size tells you one measurement. It says nothing about how long your legs are, where the jeans will sit on your hips or how the fabric will fall over your thighs. Most brands solve this with an average body and a few lengths. If you are taller, shorter or simply built differently, you end up hemming, rolling or settling.

What height and weight tell us

Your height tells us the length you need, so the hem lands exactly where it should — on the shoe for a straight or relaxed cut, at the ankle for a skinny cut. Your weight, together with your size, helps us understand the proportions, so the rise and the leg feel right when you move, not just when you stand still.

Choosing your cut

Skinny is close to the leg from hip to ankle. It works best if you like a sharp silhouette with chunky shoes or boots. Our Zebra Patch skinny jeans are mid-rise with a raw hem.

Relaxed gives more room through the thigh and a straighter leg. It is the easy everyday cut, great with sneakers and oversized tops. See the relaxed Zebra Patch jeans.

Flare fits through the hip and opens below the knee, which visually lengthens the leg. Try our logo flare jeans with a heel or a platform.

Three tips before you order

  1. Measure yourself without shoes and use your real height, not the one on your ID.
  2. Think about the shoes you wear most with jeans — that decides the length you want.
  3. If you are between two sizes, message us. We would rather help before we cut than after.

Made once, made for you

Every pair we make is finished by hand in Bucharest and adjusted before it ships. It takes a little longer than grabbing jeans off a shelf, but you get a pair that fits from day one.

posts.title: How to Style Statement Jeans: 5 Looks That Let the Denim Talk
posts.description: Patched, painted, one of a kind. Five easy ways to style statement jeans for day, night and travel.
posts.html:
Statement jeans are the loudest piece in the outfit. The trick is simple: let them lead and keep everything else clean.

1. Black and simple on top

A plain black tee or a fitted zip-up top keeps the attention on the denim. Try our Sporty Top or the black logo tee with hand-patched jeans and white sneakers.

2. One colour from the jeans

Pick one colour from the patches or the paint and repeat it once — a cap, a bag or socks. It makes the outfit look planned without trying too hard.

3. Oversized hoodie, slim jeans

Volume on top, a close fit below. An oversized hoodie over skinny statement jeans is the easiest streetwear proportion there is.

4. Dress them up

Statement denim works at night too. Add a blazer, a heel or polished boots and a small shoulder bag. The contrast between tailoring and hand-finished denim is what makes it interesting.

5. Travel look

For a flight or a city weekend, wear the jeans with a soft long sleeve and a crossbody bag. Comfortable, but you still look like you arrived somewhere.

Why every pair is different

Our Zebra Patch jeans and art jeans are patched and painted by hand, so no two pairs are identical. Treat them like a piece of art you wear: wash cold, inside out, and let them age with you.

posts.title: Why We Use Organic Cotton from Portugal for Our Tops
posts.description: What organic cotton is, why Portugal, and how to care for your cotton pieces so they last for years.
posts.html:
A great top starts with the fabric. That is why our cotton tops and tees are made with organic cotton from Portugal.

What organic cotton means

Organic cotton is grown without synthetic pesticides and fertilisers. For you, the difference is in the hand feel: it is soft from the first wear and comfortable on the skin.

Why Portugal

Portugal has one of the strongest textile traditions in Europe, with mills that care about consistency and finishing. Working with European cotton also means shorter transport to our studio in Bucharest.

Quality over quantity

We work only with quality materials, and some of our pieces use sustainable, eco-conscious fabrics. We prefer to make fewer pieces, made to order, instead of producing stock that ends up unsold.

How to care for cotton tops

  • Wash at 30°C, inside out, with similar colours.
  • Skip the tumble dryer — dry flat or on a hanger to keep the shape.
  • Iron on the reverse side, never directly on prints or embroidery.

Pieces to start with

The white baby top, the black logo tee and the oversized burgundy hoodie are the easiest pieces to build a wardrobe around.

posts.title: Custom-Made vs Fast Fashion: What You Actually Get
posts.description: Made-to-order fashion takes a few more days. Here is what you get in return: fit, quality and pieces nobody else has.
posts.html:
Fast fashion is quick and cheap. Custom-made is made for one person. Here is the honest difference.

Fit

Fast fashion is cut for an average body in a few standard sizes. A custom-made piece starts from you: at bymarccc you give us your height and weight and we adjust the length and fit before it ships.

Quality

When a piece is made to order, there is no reason to cut corners to hit a volume target. We use quality materials, organic cotton from Portugal for our cotton tops, and hand finishing on our denim.

Uniqueness

Hand-applied patches and paint mean no two pairs of our statement jeans are the same. With our custom painted bags you can even send your own photos and we build the design with you.

Less waste

Making to order means we do not produce mountains of stock that may never sell. It is a slower model, but it is a more responsible one.

The trade-off

You wait a few more days. In return, you get a piece that fits, lasts and feels like yours. Start with our logo flare jeans or logo leggings.
